eligibility_evidence: Role Description This is a full-time hybrid role for a Network Engineer, primarily based in Qesm Ain Shams with flexibility for some work from home.
Ability to work collaboratively in a hybrid environment, communicate clearly, and manage tasks with minimal supervision.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Team members are encouraged to contribute innovative ideas and grow their technical expertise while working on diverse regional projects. Qualifications Strong skills in Network Engineering and Network Design, including planning, implementing, and optimizing LAN/WAN environments. Hands-on experience with Network Administration, such as configuring routers, switches, firewalls, and managing IP addressing and VLANs. Proficiency in Troubleshooting network issues, performing root-cause analysis, and resolving performance and connectivity problems.
